quotes.text: 1. Architectural character: This structure is a large granite Gothic Revival house designed in 1835-36 by Richard Upjohn/ who later designed Trinity Church in New Tork City. Especially significant are the stairway, details, and large-scale interior spaces.

quotes.text: "The notebooks [of Richard Upjohn] of 1835 are full of entries of letters and packages sent to R. H. Gardiner, Gardiner, Maine, for the Gothic mansion 'Oaklands, 1 which was begun in that year. The original drawings fsee HABS photocopies], signed Rd. Upjohn, Arch, 1 include plans for the ground and second floors with the pochl in gray and elevations of the east, north, and south fronts, all at the unusual scale of twelve feet to an inch.
